prompt:
Same art style as the reference frames, which are the locked seed: sumi-e ink wash on warm paper, flat fills, palette limited to paper-cream, mist-pale, wash greys and ink-black. Third-person follow view from slightly above and behind a small traveller in a straw hat. COMPOSITION (STYLE-BIBLE section 5, mandatory): a dark near-vertical cliff mass fills the LEFT side of the frame with vertical fracture lines; a bright cloud-sea void fills the RIGHT side; the walkable path is the narrow lighter ledge on the seam between them, with a defined dark edge where it meets the void. Horizon high, void fills the lower-right. Cliff tops flat, faces near-vertical, no rounded rock. Torii are vermilion post-and-lintel gates placed in sequence along the path as waypoints; vermilion appears on the torii and nowhere else. Crows are ink-black, never coloured. No floating platforms: every ledge is attached to the cliff. No text, no UI, no light source, no cast shadows. Birds: none anywhere unless the segment text asks for one crow; never a bird in flight.

Segment 4, the last of the chapter. FRAME LAYOUT: the dark cliff wall occupies the whole left half of the frame from bottom edge to top edge and never ends; the right half is bright cloud-sea void with nothing standing in it (no pillar, no stack, no island, no bridge, no platform). The path is one narrow ledge running along the base of that wall, receding into the distance. Along it, in order: the traveller in the foreground; a short gap where the ledge breaks and resumes; just past the gap a dark stone slab protruding sideways out of the wall across the ledge; one black crow perched on a knob of the wall beside the gap; further on, the ledge meets a sheer rock step about twice a person's height cut into the same wall; on top of that step, still against the wall, exactly one vermilion torii. Only one torii in the image.
